registry.description: Base URL of the Confluent Schema Registry. Credentials come from the same CSR environment variables as fetch-csr.

normalize.description: Ask Schema Registry to normalize candidates before checking them.

candidates.description: Local schemas that are about to be registered. Any incompatible candidate fails the verify phase before publication.

subject.description: Existing registry subject whose effective compatibility policy should be applied.

path.description: Candidate schema file, relative to the verify step input.

schemaType.description: Schema format. Inferred from .avsc, .json or .proto when omitted.
